posts.title: The Tower of Retro-Babble: Data East
posts.description: image from the Data East Fandom page Data East. We’re not number one, and we don’t try harder. Founded in 1976 by Tetsuo Fukuda, Data East started making video games three years later, and became famous for early hits like Burgertime and Bump ‘n Jump. posts.title: Back from Extinction
posts.description: Here's my latest project! It's Digital Dinosaurs , a book on the history and inner workings of 20th century game consoles and handhelds. Not every system is featured in this meaty tome (sorry, Gamate. Also, deeply sorry about your name. Must have been tough for you in handheld high school), but with forty favorites spanning nearly thirty years, there's a whole lot of fun reading in store for video
